author: Dale Philip
description:
The Betawi people (the natives of Jakarta) have some tasty traditional foods. The most famous being Soto Betawi, a beef soup with rich, creamy, aromatic broth made from coconut milk and cow's milk. That's what I started off this Betawi culinary adventure with.

I tried it at a legendry restaurant called 'Soto Betawi Haji Husen' that people have been recommending to me for years. It's  been a super popular with Jakarta locals since it opened way back in 1988.

Of course the soup was incredibly delicious and the beef was tender and juicy. It's one place I'll happily return to again and again, even though it's very far from my hotel.

Feeling good, with my stomach full of Soto Betawi, I went on the hunt for a nice batik shirt with a Betawi pattern to wear for the rest of the Betawi foodie adventure. But as always in a Dale Philip vlog, the thing that should be easy to find wasn't easy at all. We always get there in the end though.
